spec_match.rationale: Runs the explainer's exact documented detection ('type' in GamepadButton.prototype), checks the readonly-accessor shape the WebIDL `readonly attribute GamepadButtonType type` implies, and teaches the exact three-value enum from w3c/gamepad#196 — no invented vocabulary.

interactive.rationale: The probe button executes the real checks (observed returning false in an unflagged browser — it can fail), and the enum illustration is driven by keyboard/click with live classification output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the exact-surface probe plus a labelled keyboard-driven enum illustration; the page delivers both.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles missing GamepadButton interface, present-interface-missing-attribute, and descriptor inspection separately; the unsupported outcome names the flag AND the not-yet-landed CL as distinct causes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776, the explainer, and the spec PR.

conformance.rationale: The suite's type-attribute-on-prototype and type-is-readonly-accessor assertions mirror exactly what this page probes, failing honestly where unsupported.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium both-viewport run verified checklist verdicts PASS/FAIL/FAIL (honest false), keyboard Enter on the illustration, live-region updates, zero non-environmental console/network failures — but no flag-on browser exists in this sandbox to observe the passing branch.

telemetry_health.rationale: type-probe-supported and type-probe-unsupported-honest are separate asserts; the unsupported branch is never counted as support.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; sim buttons override background AND color together (ivory/black, pressed black/ivory); pass/fail edges use emerald/rose borders with black text on light backgrounds (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Illustration buttons are native <button>s with aria-pressed and aria-labels naming the simulated enum value, statuses are aria-live=polite outputs, and keyboard activation was exercised.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800; all buttons >=44px; the sim-group columns collapse via auto-fit minmax.

openQuestions.title: Capture the supported-branch screenshot once a flag-on build exposes the attribute
openQuestions.detail: When Chromium CL 7760763 reaches a channel, run with --enable-blink-features=GamepadButtonTypes to observe the PASS/PASS/PASS checklist and confirm the descriptor detail line (getter, no setter, enumerable/configurable per WebIDL) renders as expected, then refresh this critique's runtime_evidence.

guidanceConsulted.query: high frequency live readout requestAnimationFrame polling accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons, accessible names distinguishing simulated content, polite live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every illustration control is a native button whose aria-label says 'illustration of enum value X'; the classification readout is an aria-live=polite output and repeats the 'simulated, not from a device' framing in text.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of status cards without horizontal overflow narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit minmax multi-column groups with min-width:0 so columns collapse on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three enum groups use repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr)) with min-width:0 and stack to one column at 360px; overflow measured 0px.

summary: Feature-detection page probing the exact documented surface, honestly failing today, with exact GamepadButtonTypes flag steps and a clearly-labelled keyboard-driven illustration of the standard/non-standard/trackpad vocabulary for visitors without hardware. Verified headlessly on both viewport classes with a clean console apart from the environmental fonts.googleapis failure.
